sources.name: Integrated Government Online Directory
sources.maintainer: National Informatics Centre, Ministry of Electronics and Information Technology
sources.accessMethod: Resumable normal-TLS curl/Schannel retrieval of public navigation, listing HTML and exact offset/limit AJAX routes observed in source JavaScript and browser scroll
sources.coverage: Union, state/UT, district, local bodies, judiciary, legislature and sectors as described by IGOD
sources.limitations: Directory evidence does not certify current destination availability or ownership. Some organizations have no URL. Public offset/limit requests are constrained to the source-provided page sizes; unsupported larger limit returned 302 and was not used.
sources.robotsObservation: Public paths allowed except /docs/; no crawl delay provided. Collector uses one request at a time, at least one second apart, plus caching.
sources.reproductionPermission: Pending NIC permission; user instructed local development first and permission before public distribution

sources.name: National Portal of India web directory
sources.maintainer: National Informatics Centre, Ministry of Electronics and Information Technology
sources.accessMethod: Normal-TLS cached HTML cross-check; static page still displays dynamic Loading/zero metadata. Prior normal browser request returned 403.
sources.coverage: Apex bodies, ministries, states/UTs, judiciary, legislature and districts; the page attributes its data to IGOD
sources.limitations: This is the same IGOD-derived directory, not an independent source inventory. No complete export mechanism established; no zero-result completeness claim.
sources.robotsObservation: User-agent * allows paths with a 10-second crawl delay; this alone is not bulk-reuse permission.

sources.name: National Portal of India services directory
sources.maintainer: National Informatics Centre, Ministry of Electronics and Information Technology
sources.limitations: Static HTML showed zero while the interactive home displayed a much larger count; do not derive an inventory count from either without validating the live data mechanism.

sources.name: Former National Government Services Portal
sources.maintainer: National Informatics Centre, Ministry of Electronics and Information Technology
sources.accessMethod: Historical pages and current redirect inspected manually
sources.limitations: The legacy portal announced discontinuation effective 15 May 2026; its root now redirects to india.gov.in/services. Do not import old service URLs as current entry points.

sources.name: Open Government Data Platform / LGD dataset catalog
sources.maintainer: Not re-established in this run; automated retrieval blocked
sources.accessMethod: Normal-TLS robots check and observed www redirect; content collection stopped by robots.txt
sources.coverage: Potential official LGD datasets; no data rows imported
sources.limitations: https://www.data.gov.in/robots.txt disallows all automated paths. No API key requested or API restriction bypassed. Next step: permitted official dataset/API access.

sources.name: Local Government Directory
sources.maintainer: Ministry of Panchayati Raj, Government of India
sources.accessMethod: Normal-TLS curl public source-linked state-code and state-wise entity summary tables; CAPTCHA forms not submitted
sources.coverage: Administrative denominators displayed: 36 states/UTs, 784 districts, 5050 urban and 262839 rural local bodies
sources.limitations: State IDs and aggregate denominators acquired for all 36 states/UTs. Individual district/local-body identifiers and website mappings remain unresolved; those reports require CAPTCHA. Aggregate unit existence does not prove a website.
